## Plugin reference

- Description: Each conversation's last context reading — what fills its agent's context window, as the harness measured it — in the conversations_ext_context_usage table: recordContextUsage, which a conversation runtime calls with each reading its agent reports, and the lookup-only conversations.context-usage collection the context ring reads. No read ever asks the agent.
